ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S2 Fanout Search extends the validated JS1.1S1 playtest for RimWorld 1.5. The S1 >=256 ThingRequest slow-search fast path remains intact. JD2 showed that the residual JobGiver P95 tail is dominated by many repeated small and medium GenClosest searches inside one JobPackage rather than one huge source, so S2 adds IList-backed custom search-set acceleration from 32 candidates and a per-JobPackage fanout trigger: after 24 ClosestThingReachable calls or 1024 cumulative source candidates, later searches with at least 16 candidates may use the same stable nearest-first original-validator plus live-CanReach path. JobGiver Global nearest-first now starts at 32 candidates. Unsupported source shapes, priority Global searches, unusual traverse modes and failures remain Vanilla-authoritative. JR1/JR1.1 Regionwise and global Region.Allows experiments remain retired. ReachProfile keeps JS1.1R prediction/build behavior and the embedded rolling fuse.
